Extensions

Create script extensions to customize Manager functionality.

Note: This is a legacy feature. Consider using the new extensions system instead.

Name

Enter a descriptive name for this script extension.

Script

Enter the JavaScript code to be injected. The code will run after the page loads.

Location

Choose where this script should be injected - on a specific page or everywhere.

CustomLocation

Enter the URL path where the script should run (e.g., 'sales-invoices' for the sales invoices page).

Inactive

Check to temporarily disable this script extension without deleting it.
